reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    HousingQA Sample:
      - state: Georgia
      - focus_year: 2021

    Question:
      "Is the bailiff an individual empowered by law to execute a writ of eviction?"
*/

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Scenario facts (question's factual statement)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

scenario_state(georgia).
scenario_focus_year(2021).

% The individual/role asked about in the question.
scenario_actor(bailiff_person).
scenario_actor_role(bailiff_person, bailiff).

% The writ at issue (modeled as a writ of possession / eviction writ).
scenario_writ(writ_1).
scenario_writ_type(writ_1, writ_of_possession).

% Helper predicate that "summarizes" the scenario in logic form.
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_state(georgia),
    scenario_focus_year(2021),
    scenario_actor(Actor),
    scenario_actor_role(Actor, bailiff),
    scenario_writ(Writ),
    scenario_writ_type(Writ, writ_of_possession).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Statute translation (GA Code  44-7-55 (2021))
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/*
  GA Code  44-7-55 (2021) (key parts encoded)

  - Court shall issue a writ of possession after judgment against tenant.
  - Any writ of possession issued pursuant to this article shall authorize removal
    of the tenant / personal property and permit placement as designated by the
    landlord and approved by the executing officer. (Subsection (c) language)
  - Nothing in this Code section shall require a sheriff, constable, or marshal to
    execute a writ of possession within 30 days... (Subsection (e))

  The statute text refers to an "executing officer" and specifically references
  sheriffs, constables, and marshals in connection with executing the writ.
*/

% GA Code  44-7-55: A writ of possession authorizes removal by an executing officer.
% (We model this as: if there is a writ_of_possession, it is executable by a legally
% recognized executing officer.)
statute_ga_44_7_55_writ_authorizes_removal(writ_of_possession).

% GA Code  44-7-55(e): mentions sheriff, constable, or marshal in the context of executing.
% We treat these as the roles clearly contemplated as executing officers for writs of possession.
statute_ga_44_7_55_executing_officer_role(sheriff).
statute_ga_44_7_55_executing_officer_role(constable).
statute_ga_44_7_55_executing_officer_role(marshal).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Legal reasoning predicates
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

% A role is legally empowered (under the encoded statute) to execute a writ of possession
% if the role is one of the executing-officer roles referenced by GA Code  44-7-55 (2021).
legal_empowered_to_execute_writ(Role, WritType) :-
    statute_ga_44_7_55_writ_authorizes_removal(WritType),
    statute_ga_44_7_55_executing_officer_role(Role).

% Extract the scenario's actor role.
scenario_role_at_issue(Role) :-
    scenario_actor(Actor),
    scenario_actor_role(Actor, Role).

% Determine whether, in this scenario, the actor is empowered to execute the writ.
scenario_actor_empowered_to_execute_writ :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_role_at_issue(Role),
    scenario_writ(Writ),
    scenario_writ_type(Writ, WritType),
    legal_empowered_to_execute_writ(Role, WritType).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Answer predicate (deterministic yes/no)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_actor_empowered_to_execute_writ,
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Main entrypoint
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Is the bailiff an individual empowered by law to execute a writ of eviction?
